description: The user’s Ania wallet balance (prepaid Ania credits, shown in US$ for non-Portuguese users, 1 credit = R$1), this connection’s monthly spending cap and how much of it is used. Call before quoting/buying or when the user asks what they have or can spend. To add credits, use top_up.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

title: Wallet balance and limits
